About

Senior CAD & Mechanical Design Engineer with 7 years designing sheet metal, plastic, and machined components for ATM, vending machine, elevator, and aerospace applications. Working knowledge of structural steel detailing in Tekla Structures, grounded practice in GD&T (ASME Y14.5), tolerance stack-up, DFM/DFA, BOM creation, and weld-joint design — supported by FEA concepts in ANSYS Workbench and robotic weld-path simulation in RoboDK. Currently Senior CAD Engineer at alfaTKG Integrated Solutions India Pvt. Ltd, Chennai, with international client engagement experience including a 3-week on-site technical assignment in Japan. Delivered 50+ complex assemblies across multiple product lines with zero quality rejections.
